description: This file defines a class 'ConfigFileWatcher' that monitors a configuration file for changes, utilizing a file watching mechanism to trigger a callback when the file or its directory changes.

classes.name: ConfigFileWatcher
classes.description: A final class that implements file watching for a specific configuration file using a file watcher.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ConfigFileWatcher with a URL and a callback to execute on change. Sets up a SimpleFileWatcher to monitor the target file and directory.
